scope_gaps.note: Labels the hardware key as FIDO/WebAuthn; the snapshots never use the term FIDO and never link hardware keys to WebAuthn.
Advice concerns login prompts the user did not start (unsolicited or repeated push prompts); the sources only describe approving a push after entering data on a fake page.
Compares push with 'poprawnie wdrożony WebAuthn'; sources compare with passkeys and say nothing about correct implementation in relation to phishing resistance.
Names session theft and account-recovery fraud as residual risks; neither is stated in the cited snapshots (only the malware risk for passkeys in a password manager is).
